name: kk-socio-cultural-bench-mc
description:
Description
	

We introduce KazBench-KK, a comprehensive 7,111-question multiple-choice benchmark designed to assess large language models’ understanding of culturally grounded Kazakh knowledge. By combining expert-curated topics with LLM-assisted web mining, we create a diverse dataset spanning 17 culturally salient domains, including pastoral traditions, social hierarchies, and contemporary politics. Beyond evaluation, KazBench-KK serves as a practical tool for field linguists… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/zxczxzxczxczxc/kk-socio-cultural-bench-mc.
reputation: A newly introduced, specialized multiple-choice benchmark for Kazakh cultural knowledge with limited adoption so far but useful for low-resource language evaluation.
